name: Sun
notes: Reference origin. Adopted solar properties; NASA Sun facts and the IAU 2015 nominal effective temperature. Absolute visual magnitude +4.83: NASA Sun Fact Sheet (9 May 2024), https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/sunfact.html .

name: Sirius A
notes: Sirius system position and physical properties use Bond et al. (2017), including the adopted 378.9 mas parallax. The component offset is below this catalog's spatial precision. No binary orbital motion; Galactic conversion documented in README.
